description: Receipt-calibrated task estimation for Fable-led teams. COMP-FABLE-ASTRA has Fable assign a tier per task (critical / standard / fast) from its own judgment. Close the loop: after each wave compare every task's planned tier with its receipt (STRAT-USAGE-SPLIT token split, cost, retries, review findings against that task), record the miss, and feed a compact calibration table into Fable's planning prompt for the next wave and the next run. Consumer of STRAT-LEARN-COST; the E3 complexity-triage idea in the ideabox is the shape. Depends on COMP-FABLE-ASTRA shipping. COMP-TEAMS: Agent Team Presets M medium
